integrity.claim_status: proved by an all-length combinatorial classification with finite independent computational checks
integrity.known_prior_coverage: earlier papers supply intersection formulas for prescribed Hamming-ball centers; no claim of novelty for those per-center formulas
integrity.verification_scope: all unordered center triples in binary dimensions three through eight; symbolic proof extends to every integer dimension at least three

limitations: The theorem concerns the binary alphabet, three distinct centers, and exactly two Hamming substitutions per read; it does not cover at-most-two errors, other alphabets, or coding rates.
The 1987 Honkala intersections-of-spheres chapter was bibliographically located but its full text was not accessible; equivalent earlier population enumeration remains a literature risk.
title: Complete triple-intersection spectrum of binary exact-two substitution spheres
